_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/keywords/test_read_ahead.py. t_read_ahead_saga is t_saga with read ahead printed on it: I draws, II gains 2 life, III makes a Human Soldier, so which chapters triggered reads straight off the hand, the life total and the battlefield. t_read_ahead_raise returns an enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield -- the arrival that was never cast, which 702.155a asks the same question of.

cards.name: Test Read Ahead Saga
cards.oracle_text:
Read ahead (Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add one after your draw step. Skipped chapters don't trigger. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Draw a card.
II — You gain 2 life.
III — Create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.

abilities.text: III — Create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.

cards.name: Test Read Ahead Return
cards.oracle_text: Return target enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
